title: color vertices lookup table
explanation:
### Description

This example colors vertices of a directed graph using a lookup table. Three vertices are positioned explicitly along the x-axis and each is assigned an integer color index mapped to red, white, or green via a three-entry lookup table. The mapper uses point field data coloring to apply the lookup table.

**dataset → input → layout → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkGraphLayout](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphLayout.html) passes through pre-set vertex positions.
- [vtkGraphToPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphToPolyData.html) converts graph to polydata.
- [vtkIntArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkIntArray.html) stores the per-vertex color index.
- [vtkLookupTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTable.html) maps integer indices to colors.
- [vtkMutableDirectedGraph](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMutableDirectedGraph.html) builds the directed graph.
- [vtkPassThroughLayoutStrategy](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPassThroughLayoutStrategy.html) preserves explicit vertex positions.
- [vtkPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPoints.html) positions vertices explicitly.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) maps polydata with point field data coloring.
